From an Interest to a Student Organization

I founded and served as President of the Muhlenberg Harry Potter Club, also known as the ’Berg Harry Potter Club or HP Club.

As with Pokémon Club, establishing it meant going through the college’s Student Government Association application and presentation process.

Making Space for a Shared Interest

I worked with the club’s board to organize in-person meetings for students interested in Harry Potter. The club was one way of turning a shared fictional world into a reason for people to spend time together on campus.

Starting and running the organization meant both establishing it formally and helping keep its meetings and communications organized.
